messages.author: 181bcebaf89c73b8
messages.subject: Using stan::math::multinomial_log directly
parts:
I'm having a problem using stan::math::multinomial_log. My test script
(taken from the stan math test script) looks like this:

#include <stan/math/prim/mat/prob/multinomial_log.hpp>

#include <RcppEigen.h>
using namespace Eigen;

// [[Rcpp::export]]
double test_multinomial_log() {
std::vector<int> ns;
ns.push_back(1);
ns.push_back(2);
Eigen::Matrix<double,Dynamic,1> theta(2,1);
theta << 0.2, 0.8;
return stan::math::multinomial_log<true>(ns,theta);
}

/*** R
test_multinomial_log()
*/

The error I get is

In file included from test.cpp:1:
In file included from
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/StanHeaders/include/stan/math/prim/mat/prob/multinomial_log.hpp:9:
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/StanHeaders/include/stan/math/prim/scal/err/check_nonnegative.hpp:40:38:
error: invalid operands to binary expression ('std::__1::vector<int,
std::__1::allocator<int> >' and 'int')
&& !(stan::get(y, n) >= 0))
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^ ~

Apologies if there is a specific stan-math mailing list I should be
asking this on!

Thank you in advance,

David.

--
David A. Knowles,
Stanford University.
E-mail: know...@gmail.com
Web: http://cs.stanford.edu/~davidknowles/

Hi David,

Try including this instead:
#include <stan/math.hpp>

That should include all of the template metaprograms in the correct order and make it work. Could you let us know if it doesn't work with that include?


Daniel

On Monday, January 18, 2016 at 8:31:05 PM UTC-5, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
How do you run it?  I cannot do sourceCpp directly as it does not put StanHeaders in it includes.

FYI, I discovered that if you put

// [[Rcpp::depends(rstan)]]

at the top of a C++ file and do sourceCpp() it reads rstan's plugin.R and uses its PKG_CPPFLAGS.

Ben
